items.title: Agent Memory Guard
items.description: [code] [pypi] OWASP runtime defense layer that screens agent memory writes for poisoning: multi-layer validation with semantic anomaly detection, entropy scoring, and provenance verification.

items.title: inspeximus (formerly mnemo) poisoning probes
items.description: [attack] [defense] Runnable probe scripts demonstrating that provenance written into a memory record is forgeable, and that a retrieval-time corroboration gate raises the cost of memory-poisoning attacks.
